text: dsh-resource-monitor 是面向 DSH 网页端的本机资源监控插件，通过会话标题栏入口和右侧栏面板展示 CPU、内存、频率、磁盘与网络趋势。它每分钟采样并保存最长 30 天的历史，提供 24 小时或 7 天视图、平均与峰值摘要，以及持续高 CPU、高内存和疑似降频事件。数据保存在本机用户目录，无需 API Key 或外部服务。

dsh-resource-monitor adds a local resource panel to the DSH web client. It samples CPU, memory, frequency, disk, and network every minute, retaining 30 days. View 24-hour or 7-day trends and sustained CPU, memory, or suspected-throttling events. Data stays local; no API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里看电脑最近几天的 CPU 和内存变化。
DSH 有没有能提醒我持续高负载或疑似降频的资源面板？
dsh-resource-monitor 的功能「资源历史与异常」：在 DSH 右侧栏查看本机 CPU、内存和频率的 24 小时或 7 天趋势、统计摘要及持续超阈值事件；数据每分钟采样并保留最长 30 天。

dsh-resource-monitor README · dsh-resource-monitor · 资源监控：A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) sidebar plugin that samples your Windows machine **once a minute**, keeps a **30-day** history, and tells you when sustained CPU load, memory pressure, or frequency throttling actually happened — instead of showing a live gauge you have to stare at.

DSH 侧栏插件：每分钟采集一次本机资源，保留 30 天历史，直接用「连续多久超阈值」判定长期高占用、内存吃紧与降频，而不是只给一个需要一直盯着看的实时仪表盘。

dsh-resource-monitor README · What it does / 功能：- Sidebar tab **资源监控**; a matching entry button also sits in the session title bar. / 侧栏 tab「资源监控」，会话标题栏也有入口按钮。
- Panel order: KPI row, conclusion box, CPU chart (85% alert line), memory chart (90% alert line), frequency chart (70% throttle line), incident list. / 面板顺序：KPI、结论框、CPU 曲线（85% 告警线）、内存曲线（90% 告警线）、频率曲线（70% 降频线）、异常列表。
- KPI row: current CPU, current memory (used / total GB), current frequency. / KPI：当前 CPU、当前内存（已用/总量 GB）、当前频率。
- Summary: range average/peak, minutes spent at ≥85% CPU, minutes at ≥90% memory, throttled minutes. / 结论：区间平均/峰值、超阈值累计分钟、降频分钟。
- Incident list (last 7 days): CPU sustained load, memory near capacity, frequency held down under load. / 异常列表（近 7 天）：CPU 长时间高占用、内存接近上限、负载下降频。
- 24h / 7d toggle, auto-refresh every 30 s. / 24 小时 / 7 天切换，30 秒自动刷新。

dsh-resource-monitor README · Detection rules / 判定规则：| Item / 项目 | Rule / 规则 |
| --- | --- |
| Sample interval / 采样间隔 | 60 s |
| Retention / 历史保留 | 30 days (`samples.jsonl`, append-only) |
| CPU alert | ≥ 85% for ≥ 10 consecutive minutes |
| Memory alert | ≥ 90% for ≥ 10 consecutive minutes |
| Throttle alert | CPU ≥ 50% while frequency ≤ 70% of maximum, for ≥ 5 consecutive minutes |

dsh-resource-monitor README · Data sources / 数据来源：- CPU / memory: Node `os.cpus()` time deltas, `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()`.
- Frequency: Windows performance counter `\Processor Information(_Total)\% of Maximum Frequency`.
- Disk: `\PhysicalDisk(_Total)\Disk Read Bytes/sec`, `Disk Write Bytes/sec` (still sampled into the history, not charted). / 磁盘读写仍写入历史，但不再绘图。
- Network: `Get-NetAdapterStatistics` cumulative bytes, converted to a rate between two samples (history only, not charted). / 网络同样只入库不绘图。
- Disk and network figures come from one `powershell.exe` child process per sample (~2–4 s, async, never blocks the UI).

dsh-resource-monitor README · No temperature readings / 不采集温度：Reading CPU core temperature on Windows (MSR / SMBus) needs a kernel driver. This plugin does not ship or load one; it deliberately infers throttling from the **frequency / maximum-frequency ratio**, which reflects the throttling event itself and needs no driver or elevation.

Windows 上读取 CPU 核心温度需要内核驱动。本插件不附带、也不加载任何驱动，改用「当前频率 / 最高频率」判定降频 —— 这个信号直接反映降频事实，且不需要驱动或提权。
section: No temperature readings / 不采集温度

text:
dsh-resource-monitor README · Install / 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XiaoLuoMin/dsh-resource-monitor
```

Then restart the DSH app so both the host and the client half load. / 装完重启 DSH 应用（host 与 client 两半都要重新加载）。

Uninstall / 卸载:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-resource-monitor
```

dsh-resource-monitor README · Data location / 数据位置：```
%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\data\resource-monitor\samples.jsonl
```

One JSON object per line, one line per minute. Delete the file to reset the history. / 每行一个 JSON 样本，每分钟一行；删除该文件即清空历史。

dsh-resource-monitor README · Layout / 结构：```
lib/index.js        host: sampling loop, 30-day history, POST /api/resource-monitor.snapshot
client/client.js    client: sidebar tab, entry button, separate CPU / memory / frequency canvas charts, summary and incident list
cordis.patch.yml    bundle insert declaration
```
